title: Secure-ArmorStands
description: 生成特殊盔甲架，避免因卡顿、掉帧误拆盔甲架Spawn invincible armor stands to prevent the tragedy of execution chambers failing due to accidentally breaking the stand during lag or frame drops while AFK.
body:
Uses the custom-tagged "★ Invincible Armor Stand ★" item to grant regular armor stands an invincible state, making them completely immune to player attacks, creeper explosions, lava, fire, and other sources of damage. This prevents the core armor stands in AFK execution chambers from being accidentally destroyed. Natively supports Folia 1.21+.

How to Use

Grant Invincibility: Hold the "Guardian Enchant Tag" and right-click on a regular armor stand.

Safe Removal: Upon successful removal, it will drop 1 regular Armor Stand and 1 Guardian Enchant Tag on the spot without any loss. Only the following three removal methods are supported:

Left-click while holding a Golden Hoe.

Sneak (Shift) + Left-click the armor stand.

Aim your crosshair directly at the armor stand and type the /delinvstand command.

Commands & Permissions

/giveinvtag - Obtain the Guardian Enchant Tag (Permission Node: invstand.admin).

/delinvstand - Forcefully remove the invincible armor stand you are currently looking at (Permission Node: OP or invstand.admin).

无敌盔甲架生成器 (Secure-ArmorStands)
插件作用
使用带有底层标签的“★ 无敌盔甲架 ★”为普通盔甲架赋予无敌状态，使其彻底免疫玩家攻击、苦力怕爆炸、岩浆和火焰等伤害，避免挂机处死室的核心盔甲架被误拆。支持 Folia 1.21+。

使用方法

赋予无敌： 手持“无敌盔甲架”右键点击普通盔甲架即可。

安全拆除： 拆除后原地无损掉落 1个普通盔甲架 和 1个卫士附魔牌。仅支持以下三种拆除方式：

手持 金锄头 左键敲击。

潜行 (Shift) + 左键 敲击盔甲架。

准心对准盔甲架输入 /delinvstand 指令。

指令与权限

/giveinvtag - 获取卫士附魔牌（权限节点: invstand.admin）。

/delinvstand - 强制拆除准心指向的无敌盔甲架（权限节点: OP 或 invstand.admin）
